text:
Two watches, almost exactly the same money. Which would you buy?

The Tudor Black Bay GMT is $5,275 at Watches of Switzerland. The Cartier Santos-Dumont is $5,250 on Cartier's US site. One is a steel sports watch with a red and blue 24-hour bezel, the other a square steel Cartier named for the Brazilian aviator.

Black Bay or Santos-Dumont? Tell us in the comments.

#watches #luxurywatches #tudor #cartier

Source: Watches of Switzerland (Tudor Black Bay GMT, US price checked 26 November 2026); Cartier US website (Santos-Dumont CRWSSA0085, US price checked 25 November 2026).
